messages:
samir: quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem: we have 4 concrete action items (tenant burst policy, scheduler hysteresis, nightly job gating, headroom reserve). need owners + dates.

rachael: i'll take tenant burst policy (elastic cushion). propose 12% cushion for 90s, then a 5m decay. will RFC + tests by 2026-04-05.

tony: i'll own scheduler hysteresis & packing window. plan: replay baseline, then test coalesce=80ms and eviction_hysteresis=4%. measurement by 2026-03-28, PR within 2w.

samir: i'll do headroom reserve proposal + telemetry for fallbacks (event_id + tenant flag). draft with cost delta by 2026-03-31.

ci-bot: Issue infra/ops#1684 created: "elastic-cushion + scheduler hysteresis" (assignee: rachael).

rachael: compaction/nightly jobs: can we gate at runner-level if global headroom <10%? i'll coordinate with batch team; gating PR targeted 2026-04-02.

tony: measurement targets: eviction_count down >=30% and p99 delta <10%. will paste replay logs to the issue.

samir: scheduling weekly 15m triage starting 2026-03-25 for 6 weeks. rotate infra oncall.

rachael: adding runbook note + customer comms template once PRs land.

samir: thanks all. update ticket with PR links when ready and we'll close loop. :thumbsup:
